info.name: DevNull
info.summary: /dev/null — Where your data goes to live.
info.description:
DevNull detects external drives connected to your server and lets you mount, scan, deduplicate and classify their contents — all from the Nextcloud interface.
**Features:** - Auto-detect USB/external drives connected to your server - One-click mount and register as Nextcloud external storage - Integrated ingest pipeline: scan, deduplicate, classify (AI) - Multi-tenant: admin mounts, users see what's shared with them - Optional daemon for real-time hotplug detection and background workers - Strategy-based architecture: works with udisks2 or sudo mount
No terminal required. Plug in a disk, click mount, let your server do the rest.
info.author: Luis Carmo
